name: What types of stair damage can Frasheski Construction repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of stair damage can Frasheski Construction repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction can repair a wide range of stair damage, including worn or broken treads, loose or missing risers, damaged stringers, unstable newel posts, and rickety handrails. We address issues with both wooden and concrete stairs, focusing on restoring safety and structural integrity. Our team can also repair cosmetic damage like scuffs and gouges. For significant structural concerns, we recommend an assessment to ensure the repair fully addresses the underlying problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction repairs worn treads, loose risers, damaged stringers, unstable newel posts, and rickety handrails for both wooden and concrete stairs.
